> 🤖 SPARQ agent

The round-2 major finding is resolved. `no_change_census` now selects the latest attributable attempt across all usable exit classes before deciding whether the run's final outcome is `no_change`. The added opposed-order transition checks cover both `no_change -> success` (excluded) and `success -> no_change` (included), so the previous filter-before-fold defect is no longer present. The surrounding attribution, null-on-unreadable behavior, ratio threshold validation, sustained firing/recovery registration, and production call-site wiring remain fail-closed and are covered by non-vacuous assertions. I found no blocker, major, or lower-severity defect in the diff.
